label: ueha
title: 上は
meaning_example: since you have kids, you should stop smoking

notes.text: The clause prior to "ue" contains a situation or fact. The clause following "ue wa" indicates the speaker's decision/hope/or resolve.
notes.html: The clause prior to "ue" contains a situation or fact. The clause following "ue wa" indicates the speaker's decision/hope/or resolve.

examples.japanese: 動物を飼う上は責任をもって世話をするべきです。
examples.body_text:
動物を飼う上は責任をもって世話をするべきです。 

since 
		you have a pet, you should pay attention to your responsibility.
examples.body_html:
動物を飼う上は責任をもって世話をするべきです。 
since you have a pet, you should pay attention to your responsibility.

examples.japanese: 彼のことだから、「やる」と言った上は、絶対にやるだろう。
examples.body_text:
彼のことだから、「やる」と言った上は、絶対にやるだろう。
 

		He's the type that when he says he will do it, he definitely will do it.
examples.body_html:
彼のことだから、「やる」と言った上は、絶対にやるだろう。  
He's the type that when he says he will do it, he definitely will do it.

examples.japanese: 事態がこうなったうえは、もう彼一人には任せてはおけない。
examples.body_text:
事態がこうなったうえは、もう彼一人には任せてはおけない。 

Since 
		the situation have gone this way,  you cannot entrust it only to him another time.
examples.body_html:
事態がこうなったうえは、もう彼一人には任せてはおけない。 
Since the situation have gone this way, you cannot entrust it only to him another time.

comments.text: Oops. On second thoughts kill that 'see also'
comments.html: Oops. On second thoughts kill that 'see also'

comments.text: ex# Although I've changed from 言って上 to 言った上, the J sounds unnatural. 「やる」と言ったからには would be more natural.
comments.html: ex# Although I've changed from 言って上 to 言った上, the J sounds unnatural. 「やる」と言ったからには would be more natural.

comments.text: What about: タバコは法律上、認められているんですよ。In this case, 上は is like "According to". According to the law, tobacco is acceptable.

related_entries.label: とき
related_entries.annotation_text: とき    (とき is almost always used for time expressions, whereas 上は can be a bit more cause and effect.) [dc]
related_entries.annotation_html: とき    (とき is almost always used for time expressions, whereas 上は can be a bit more cause and effect.) [dc]

sections.text:
上は [うえは] (ueha)

    Example: since you have kids, you should stop smoking

    Category: grammar
    Author: dc
